verse.verse_1: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-
verse.verse_2: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:
verse.verse_3: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-
verse.verse_4: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-
verse.verse_5: Taught man that which he knew not.
verse.verse_6: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,
verse.verse_7: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.
verse.verse_8: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).
verse.verse_10: A votary when he (turns) to pray?
verse.verse_11: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-
verse.verse_13: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?
verse.verse_14: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?
verse.verse_15: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-
verse.verse_17: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):
verse.verse_18: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!
verse.verse_19: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!
